title: Love carefully
brief_description: A straightforward film aimed at the undereducated adult - 8th (US) grade or below, slow learners or foreign-born residents with difficulties in English. Presents the rhythm method, the Pill, withdrawal, condoms, foam, the diaphragm, the IUD, abortion and sterilisation.
